claims.hypothesis: Dense gas is present in the AGN-driven southern outflow but not in the starburst-driven northern outflow
claims.experiment: HCN/HCO+ extreme-velocity moment maps compared with CO
claims.result: Detected at OF-Red and South-OF-Blue; undetected at North-OF-Blue (<0.06 Jy km/s)
claims.finding: Southern outflow contains dense gas; northern does not

evidence.quote: the dense gas tracers are only detected at OF-Red and South-OF-Blue, whereas they are undetected at North-OF-Blue

claims.hypothesis: Southern outflow gas is denser and more excited than the southern nucleus
claims.experiment: Line ratios in outflow vs nucleus
claims.finding: Larger dense gas fraction and higher excitation in the outflow

evidence.quote: The $R_{\rm HCO^+/CO}$ (i.e. dense gas fraction) and the $R_{32/10}$ are both larger in the southern outflow

claims.result: Dense gas fraction increases and R_32/10 decreases toward largest velocity offset
claims.finding: Suggests diffuse plus clumpy phases, possibly from jet-ISM interaction

evidence.quote: One possible explanation is a two-phase gas in the outflow

claims.hypothesis: Starburst alone cannot power the southern outflow
claims.experiment: Compare outflow kinetic power with supernova power
claims.finding: Another energy source such as AGN needed

evidence.quote: suggesting that another source of energy such as an AGN is needed to account for the observed high value of $P_{\rm kin,OF}$

why_this_method.value: Non-LTE modelling because outflow conditions can differ from ambient ISM

evidence.quote: The physical properties (e.g., temperature and density) of the outflow can be substantially different from the conditions seen in the ambient ISM.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: HCN/HCO+ enhancement cannot be explained by shocks alone

evidence.quote: It is difficult to explain the origin of the large HCN/HCO$^+$ ratio seen in the outflows by shocks alone.

limitations_admitted.value: Four lines constrain many parameters giving broad probability functions; single-phase assumption inappropriate

evidence.quote: The critical issue of this modeling is that four lines are used as input parameters to estimate five parameters, resulting in the broad probability functions.

limitations_admitted.value: Sensitivity insufficient for meaningful upper limit at North-OF-Blue

evidence.quote: Our observation sensitivity is insufficient to derive a meaningful upper limit
